steps.title: Solution
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\text{Let the three consecutive integers be}\\[5pt]&\quad x,x+1,x+2\\[5pt]&x+(x+1)+(x+2)=42\\[5pt]&3x+3=42\\[5pt]&3x=39\\[5pt]&x=13\\[5pt]&\text{The three integers are }\textcolor{#047857}{\mathbf{13,14}\textbf{ and}}\\[5pt]&\quad 15\textcolor{#047857}{\textbf{.}}\end{aligned}\]
